title: Shipment Exception Report Form
subtitle: Shipment Exception: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Shipment Exception Report Form covers shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action. The shipment exception coordinator records Shipment Exception chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Shipment Exception Report Form keeps Shipment Exception exceptions visible until the shipment exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Shipment Exception Report Form at origin, in-transit node, destination, vehicle, and recovery location. Document shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action identity before Shipment Exception begins. Compare shipment, affected unit, route event, service commitment, evidence, and recovery action findings with stated Shipment Exception criteria; route unresolved Shipment Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Shipment Exception Report Form, confirm requirements for Shipment Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Shipment Exception conditions beyond the shipment exception coordinator's role.
